# SPD-020 — Prose for the lead hold: CLAUDE.md and the spudagent definition

## Brief
[[SPD-015]] is merged, so four places in Spud's own files still describe the narrower rule. (1) `.claude/agents/spudagent.md`, "## Finishing": the `SubagentStop` hold now also fires when a child you spawned returned unrecorded or is still alive, and the block names the exact `member finish` command for each. (2) `.claude/agents/spudagent.md`, "## Sub-agents" step 3, and (3) the brief template's Limits line in `CLAUDE.md`: a background child is not killed when you return and its completion notification does not follow you, so wait for it inside your turn (poll `spud member show`) or spawn the last one in the foreground, and record a child you planned but never spawned with `--status failed`. (4) `CLAUDE.md` Law 9 and the Ledger v1 hooks bullet: below Spud the same rule is enforced for every parent by `SubagentStop`, not only for Spud by `Stop`. While there, the Commands block still says 207 tests; it is 220 on main after SPD-015. Done when: the prose matches `hook_subagent_stop` on main line by line, and the suite is still green.

## Size, persona and model decision
Spud alone, no spudagent: every deliverable is a Spud-owned file, which Law 1 reserves to Spud. Same shape as SPD-003 and SPD-009.

## Outcome
Done, by Spud alone (no spudagent: Law 1 reserves these files). `CLAUDE.md`: Law 9 now says the law binds every parent and that since [[SPD-015]] the `SubagentStop` hook holds a spudagent the same way; the Ledger v1 hooks bullet adds the child clauses and the exact commands; the brief template's Limits line tells a spudagent that a background child is not killed when it returns, that the notification does not follow it, to wait inside the turn (poll `member show`) or spawn the last child in the foreground, and that a planned, never-spawned child is recorded `--status failed`; the Commands block now reads 220 tests, about two minutes. `.claude/agents/spudagent.md`: the same two facts from the spudagent's side, in Finishing and in Sub-agents step 3. Checked against `hook_subagent_stop` on `main` after the merge (ad6766e); the suite there is `Ran 220 tests in 117.762s` / `OK` and leaves no bytecode.
